integrity: The proof derives the exact second-iterate matrix identity, uses only Rayleigh-quotient bounds for the universal frontier, gives an all-condition-number diagonal sharpness family, and proves the two-dimensional all-iterate formula analytically. Exact-rational replay from the packaged checker corroborates the algebra and explicit witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The sharp condition-number result concerns the second exact-line-search steepest-descent iterate for symmetric positive definite Stieltjes systems. Later iterates in dimension at least three and general symmetric positive definite matrices without the Stieltjes sign pattern are not classified.
title: Condition two is the sharp second-iterate positivity frontier for steepest descent
